Cyclone Akvan is expected to make landfall near Puri, Odisha, bringing back memories of the devastating 1999 Super Cyclone that claimed nearly 10,000 lives. The cyclone may make landfall early Friday morning, with wind speeds reaching 100 kmph. The Odisha government is on alert, and all schools in the expected landfall areas will remain closed from November 19 to 21.

This mother had spent 30 years taking care of her son with an intellectual disability. But when she was diagnosed with cancer, her biggest fear wasn't dying. It was wondering how her son would survive without her. 🥺
Determined to help him become independent, she began teaching him how to fry eggs, take public transportation, and take care of himself. But every failed attempt left them both frustrated and heartbroken. 💔
One night, she became so desperate that she considered ending both their lives. But her son's innocent wish to eat her fried eggs again the next day brought her back to her senses and gave her a reason to keep going. 😭
From that moment on, she changed the way she taught him. Using pictures, labels, and endless practice, she slowly helped him master everyday skills. Eventually, he learned to travel alone and cook for himself. ❤️
Then one day, she discovered that he had prepared an entire dinner all by himself. He was even working confidently at a bakery. Finally, she knew her son could live a good life even after she was gone. 🥹
But when his mother eventually passed away, the boy kept his promise to her. He held back his tears and smiled as he said goodbye, because he knew that was exactly what his mother would have wanted. 🕊️

snippet.description:
เช้าวันที่ 26 ธันวาคม 2547 แผ่นดินไหวขนาด 9.1 ใต้ทะเลนอกเกาะสุมาตรา ไม่ได้ทำให้เกิดแค่สึนามิ แต่ทำให้แผ่นดินทั้งประเทศไทยขยับด้วย ภูเก็ตเลื่อนไปทางตะวันตกเฉียงใต้ 27 ซม. ภายในไม่กี่นาที กรุงเทพฯ 8 ซม. เชียงใหม่เกือบ 3 ซม. และภูเก็ตยังไหลต่อจนรวมกว่าครึ่งเมตรภายในกลางปี 2550 คลิปนี้อธิบายว่าทำไมแผ่นเปลือกโลกถึง "ดีดกลับ" และทำไมหมุดพิกัดทั้งประเทศต้องอัปเดตใหม่

- USGS: M9.1 Sumatra–Andaman earthquake, 26 Dec 2004

🎥 Series: Penguins of Madagascar (2014)


🐧✨ Penguins of Madagascar has one penguin nobody can forget—Rico. He can't really talk, only grunt and make strange noises, yet his stomach holds a whole other dimension: whatever the team needs, he can pull it out. 🎒
At first, you take him for the squad's comic relief "ammo dump." 😆 But when the team is trapped inside a bag of Cheezy Dibbles, Skipper gives the order—"Rico, bust us out of this delicious prison"—and Rico promptly produces a bomb from his mouth and blows the bag open. 💥 Skipper nods in approval: "Nice work, Rico. You are a meaningful and valued member of this team." 🍟
His talents go far beyond that. 😲 Tracking the villain Dave, he coughs up Dave's entire snow globe collection one by one, each representing a zoo or aquarium Dave was kicked out of—from Bangalore to Dusseldorf, Osaka to Rio de Janeiro, Nairobi, Amsterdam, and Baton Rouge. Skipper takes it in and says: "Don't tell me where he has been—tell me where he will have has been next." 🌍
The best part: even intelligence comes out of his stomach. 📖 Rico spits out "a book! A film! A play!" and the team launches into a guessing game—"First word. Two syllables. Sounds like…"—until it lands on "Shanghai"! 🎯 Then he deploys a "secret weapon" made of Swiss cheese, and Skipper yells, "The cheese, it burns! Roll out!" 🧀
From bombs to snow globes, from books to cheese, Rico proves with his stomach what it truly means to keep everything hidden—and always have exactly what the team needs. 🌟🐧

snippet.title: السعودية تغير قيادة القوات المشتركة وإيران تستعد بقنبلة قذرة؟
snippet.description:
اتهامات استخباراتية جديدة لإيران بالتخطيط لاستخدام أسلحة كيماوية وقنبلة قذرة في واشنطن، وتقارير عن خطة لاستهداف ترامب بمسيّرات، بالتزامن مع تصاعد الهجمات على ناقلات النفط في مضيق هرمز.

وفي اليمن، السعودية تغيّر قائد القوات المشتركة وتكلف رئيس الأركان فياض الرويلي بقيادتها، بعد الانسحابات والتطورات الميدانية الأخيرة. إيه دلالة الجمع بين المنصبين في التوقيت ده؟

وفي جولة النهاردة من السيرك العالمي مع علي أبوالنيل، بنتابع كمان:

- قمة الصين المرتقبة واجتماع ترامب وشي وبوتين.
- اعتداءات المستوطنين في الضفة الغربية وتحقيق الجارديان عن صور الفلسطينيين لدى أمازون.
- صراع قيادة الديمقراطيين في الكونجرس الأمريكي.
- استثمارات ترامب في إنفيديا وأزمة المطارات الأمريكية.
- عودة السودانيين من الخارج وتحقيق الذهب المهرب للإمارات.

An abandoned greenhouse, forgotten for years, gets a beautiful second chance. 🌿

Watch as a neglected glasshouse slowly transforms into a cozy little home filled with colorful flowers, lush greenery, rustic furniture, a tiny wooden kitchen and warm fairy lights.

From clearing years of dust and overgrown weeds to repairing broken glass, restoring rusty frames, building a kitchen and creating a peaceful sleeping corner, every little detail brings this forgotten place back to life.

And finally, a warm cup of homemade herbal tea, fresh bread and a beautiful sunset. A little reminder that even forgotten places can become something wonderful. 🏡
